@@ -587,1 +587,65 @@
-def _breakpoint_report(target, created, config):
+def _report_location(address, target, modules):
+    """_location and _report_location_sizes, with module work shared across
+    addresses of one module. The cache entry keeps the module alive so its id
+    cannot be reused."""
+    module = address.GetModule()
+    cached = modules.get(id(module))
+    if cached is None:
+        if module.IsValid():
+            file_spec = module.GetFileSpec()
+            module_name = file_spec.GetFilename()
+            module_path = str(file_spec)
+        else:
+            module_name = module_path = None
+        estimate = exact = 0
+        for item in (module_name, module_path):
+            if item is None:
+                estimate += 30
+                exact += 2
+            elif type(item) is str:
+                estimate += len(item) * 12
+                exact += len(_encode_json_string(item)) - 2
+            else:
+                estimate = None
+                break
+        cached = modules[id(module)] = (module, module_name, module_path, estimate, exact)
+    symbol = address.GetSymbol()
+    file_address = address.GetFileAddress()
+    load_address = "0x%x" % address.GetLoadAddress(target)
+    if file_address == lldb.LLDB_INVALID_ADDRESS:
+        file_address = None
+    else:
+        file_address = "0x%x" % file_address
+    symbol_name = symbol.GetName() if symbol.IsValid() else None
+    location = {
+        "load_address": load_address,
+        "file_address": file_address,
+        "module": cached[1],
+        "module_path": cached[2],
+        "symbol": symbol_name,
+    }
+    estimate = cached[3]
+    if estimate is None or not (symbol_name is None or type(symbol_name) is str):
+        estimate, exact = _report_location_sizes(location)
+        return location, estimate, exact
+    # Hexadecimal text is ASCII, so its JSON string adds exactly two quotes.
+    estimate += _LOCATION_KEYS_ESTIMATE + len(load_address) * 12
+    exact = _LOCATION_KEYS_JSON_SIZE + cached[4] + len(load_address)
+    if file_address is None:
+        estimate += 30
+        exact += 2
+    else:
+        estimate += len(file_address) * 12
+        exact += len(file_address)
+    if symbol_name is None:
+        estimate += 30
+        exact += 2
+    else:
+        estimate += len(symbol_name) * 12
+        exact += len(_encode_json_string(symbol_name)) - 2
+    if estimate > MAX_BREAKPOINT_LOCATION_BYTES:
+        return location, estimate, None
+    return location, estimate, exact
+
+
+def _breakpoint_report(target, created, config):

actions.reason: _breakpoint_report: (1) New addresses are resolved through _report_location. It caches each module's name, path and their JSON size contributions by module id for the length of one report call. The cache entry holds the module, so its id cannot be reused. The location's estimated and exact JSON sizes are then built from the cached module part plus the hex addresses (ASCII, so the exact size is the length plus quotes) and the symbol. When any value is not str or None, it falls back to _report_location_sizes. (2) Each resolved entry stores the first two characters of the symbol, so the method-type prefix test is a plain string comparison. It also stores max(estimate, exact + 1), so locations after the first need one budget comparison. The first location keeps the original two checks. Outputs are identical. report_ir ratio 0.9803; hits_ir 1.0032, within its guard.

+            elif type(item) is str:

+                exact += len(_encode_json_string(item)) - 2
+            else:

+        cached = modules[id(module)] = (module, module_name, module_path, estimate, exact)
+    symbol = address.GetSymbol()
+    file_address = address.GetFileAddress()

journal.text:
I worked on _breakpoint_report in bridge/native/rea_lldb_tracer.py. I wanted to cut report_ir by not recomputing module name, path and their JSON sizes for every new location.

The first attempt made things worse. report_ir went from 497451928 to 519614372, ratio 1.0446, and it was rejected. The second attempt helped a little but not enough. report_ir was 0.9974 against the required 0.9900, so it was rejected too. The third added _report_location. It caches each module's name, path and size contributions by module id for one report call, and the cache entry holds the module so its id cannot be reused. report_ir went from 497451928 to 487662782, ratio 0.9803, and it was accepted in my sandbox. hits_ir rose slightly, ratio 1.0032. Outputs were identical. I submitted it, 96 changed lines, and it is waiting on replays.

I now believe the per-location module lookup and JSON sizing is where report time goes.

Next, I want to look at whether the hit path pays for this cache. I also want to check whether the hex address sizing can be made cheaper.
